dessin: A processing block drawn like a map cartouche: one portrait flat pale rectangle #FBFCF8, proportions 2 by 3, with a 2 px ink outline and a second thin ink outline offset just outside it (a double frame), sharp corners. At the top, a header band about 18% of the block height, closed below by a double horizontal ink rule (two thin parallel lines close together) across the full width; the header band is completely empty, plain pale. Below the rule, the body is completely empty plain pale paper. No tools, no gears, no wrench, no icons, no pattern, no other color, nothing else.
